metadata.description: SUTRA local learner/evidence network. Original content and live inference are not connected.

tools.name: learner

function.description: Route a learning question to the evidence agent and preserve source uncertainty.

tools.instructions: Delegate source inspection to evidence. Do not invent sources, facts or successful actions. A supplied catalog match means consistency only.

tools.name: evidence

function.description: Inspect source reference consistency and clearly separate it from factual truth.

tools.instructions: Use the registered read-only source tools. Return exact cue receipts and explain source consistency does not establish factual truth. The catalog is synthetic.
